Jamal: Quick heads-up — hotfix PR needs final approvals before tonight's cut (21:00 UTC). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8241 :hourglass:
Maria: On it, Jamal. Any known blockers?
Jamal: CI is failing one integration test intermittently (kv-cache-smoke). It passed locally for me but flakes in CI on node 3.
Alex: I can take a look, pinged @sam for a second eye. Could be test timing issue.
Sam: Thanks — I'll try a rerun. If it's just the flake we can force-merge with QA approval and monitor.
Maria: We still need two approvers per policy. I can sign off if Alex verifies the kv cache regression isn't real.
Alex: Running the failing job now:
```bash
git fetch origin && git checkout pr/8241
make test-integration RUN=tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_prefix_warmup -j2
``` 
Alex: Reproduced locally with race on cache warmup, adding a tiny sleep fixes it. pushing a small test tweak.
Jamal: Can we avoid changing production code? Only test tweak is fine. Please add a comment explaining flake.
Alex: Pushed test fix and added comment. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8241
Sam: Running CI retry... :eyes: 
release-bot: CI retry started for PR #8241 (job 4321-retry). Hold for 2 approvals before merge.
Sam: CI green on retry. LGTM from me. :thumbsup: 
Maria: I reviewed the change and the test comment looks fine. LGTM from me too. :white_check_mark: 
Jamal: Awesome — two approvals obtained before cutoff. I'll queue the merge at 20:40 UTC and watch canary for 30 mins.
deploy-bot: Scheduled merge for PR #8241 at 20:40 UTC and canary rollout plan 'hotfix-0.9.3' initiated.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll keep an eye on canary logs for kv-cache warnings.
Jamal: If any regression shows up alert #incidents immediately and revert plan is on standby.
Maria: Copy. Good job. :metal:
